title: Inception
description: A skilled thief who enters people's dreams to steal secrets is given a difficult mission to plant an idea inside the mind of a powerful businessman.

title: Interstellar
description: A group of astronauts travels through a mysterious wormhole in space to search for a new habitable planet while humanity struggles to survive on Earth.

title: The Dark Knight
description: A masked vigilante protects Gotham City while facing a dangerous criminal mastermind who creates chaos and challenges the city's sense of order.

title: The Matrix
description: A computer programmer discovers that the reality he knows is an artificial simulation and joins a rebellion against intelligent machines controlling humanity.

title: Titanic
description: A young woman from a wealthy family falls in love with a poor artist during the maiden voyage of a luxurious ship that is destined for disaster.

title: The Shawshank Redemption
description: A banker who is wrongly imprisoned forms a strong friendship with another prisoner and secretly plans his escape while maintaining hope for freedom.

title: The Godfather
description: The aging head of a powerful Italian-American crime family prepares his reluctant son to take control of the family's criminal empire.

title: Forrest Gump
description: A kind-hearted man with a simple outlook on life experiences important historical events and an unexpected journey involving friendship, love, and success.

title: Gladiator
description: A respected Roman general is betrayed and forced into slavery, eventually becoming a gladiator who seeks revenge against the emperor who destroyed his family.

title: Avengers: Endgame
description: After a devastating defeat against a powerful enemy, surviving superheroes attempt to reverse the destruction and bring back the people they lost.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
description: A young hobbit inherits a powerful ring and begins a dangerous journey with a group of companions to prevent an evil ruler from reclaiming it.

title: Jurassic Park
description: Scientists create a theme park populated by genetically engineered dinosaurs, but a security failure causes the prehistoric creatures to escape and threaten the visitors.

title: The Lion King
description: A young lion prince must overcome tragedy, leave his home, and eventually return to reclaim his rightful place as king of the animal kingdom.

title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
description: An orphaned boy discovers that he is a wizard and attends a magical school where he makes friends and encounters a dangerous mystery connected to his past.

title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
description: A young superhero asks for magical help to make people forget his secret identity, but the spell goes wrong and brings villains from other universes into his world.

title: Iron Man
description: A wealthy weapons manufacturer is captured by terrorists and builds a powerful armored suit to escape, later using his technology to become a superhero.

title: The Martian
description: An astronaut is accidentally left behind on Mars and must use science, engineering, and creativity to survive while NASA works to bring him home.

title: Avatar
description: A former marine enters an alien world using a genetically engineered body and becomes involved in a conflict between human colonizers and the planet's native population.

title: Dune
description: A young nobleman becomes involved in a struggle over a desert planet whose valuable resource is essential to interstellar travel and political power.

title: Oppenheimer
description: A brilliant physicist leads a secret scientific project during World War II to develop the first atomic bomb and later faces political and moral consequences.

title: The Prestige
description: Two rival magicians become obsessed with defeating each other and spend years using increasingly dangerous methods to uncover the secrets behind their greatest illusions.

title: Whiplash
description: A young ambitious drummer joins an elite music conservatory and faces an extremely demanding instructor who pushes him toward perfection through intense training.

title: Parasite
description: A poor family gradually becomes involved with a wealthy household by taking jobs there, but their attempt to improve their lives leads to unexpected conflict and deception.

title: Mad Max: Fury Road
description: A warrior and a group of women flee across a dangerous desert while being chased by a brutal ruler and his heavily armed followers.

title: The Social Network
description: A Harvard student creates a revolutionary social networking website, but disputes over ownership, friendship, and ambition follow the rapid growth of his company.

title: Rocky
description: A small-time boxer receives an unexpected opportunity to fight the heavyweight champion and trains intensely while trying to prove himself.

title: The Pursuit of Happyness
description: A struggling father facing financial hardship works relentlessly to secure a better future for himself and his young son while pursuing a career in finance.

title: Toy Story
description: A group of toys secretly comes to life when humans are away, and a cowboy toy struggles with jealousy when a new space-themed toy becomes the child's favorite.

title: Finding Nemo
description: A cautious clownfish travels across the ocean to find his captured son and receives help from a friendly but forgetful fish along the way.

title: The Hangover
description: Three friends wake up after a wild bachelor party in Las Vegas and try to reconstruct the previous night's events while searching for their missing friend.

title: John Wick
description: A retired assassin returns to the criminal underworld after a violent attack takes away something precious to him, beginning a relentless mission of revenge.
